items.title: Шэдоухарт из Baldur's Gate 3 получит собственную книгу-приквел: жрица Шар расследует загадочное убийство
items.text: Вселенная Baldur’s Gate 3 продолжит расширяться за пределами видеоигр. Издательство Penguin Random House готовит художественную книгу Baldur’s Gate 3: Shadowheart, посвящённую одной из главных героинь RPG от Larian Studios. Читателям расскажут о событиях из прошлого Шэдоухарт, когда она ещё служила богине тьмы Шар и выполняла поручения своего ордена. Автором произведения выступит Таша Шури, известная по фэнтезийному роману «Жасминовый трон», который получил Всемирную премию фэнтези. Книга входит в её трилогию «Пылающие королевства». Теперь писательнице предстоит перенести своё творчество в мир Forgotten Realms и раскрыть историю персонажа, чьё прошлое в Baldur’s Gate 3 играет важную роль. По сюжету Шэдоухарт предстоит расследовать загадочное убийство одного из членов ордена Шар. Действие развернётся в Верхнем городе, а сама героиня на этом этапе истории ещё полностью связана со служением тёмной богине. Таким образом, книга позволит подробнее познакомиться с жизнью жрицы до событий игры и узнать, с какими испытаниями ей приходилось сталкиваться задолго до встречи с главным героем. Baldur’s Gate 3: Shadowheart уже доступна для предварительного заказа в зарубежных магазинах. Например, на Amazon книгу предлагают за 31 доллар. Выход запланирован на 8 июня 2027 года. Это не первая литературная история, посвящённая спутникам из Baldur’s Gate 3. В 2026 году Penguin Random House выпустило книгу об Астарионе, написанную Урсулой Вернон, более известной под псевдонимом Т. Кингфишер. Тепе

items.title: Baldur's Gate 3 получила масштабное обновление нейроозвучки - был переработан весь игровой текст
items.text: Для Baldur’s Gate 3 вышла версия 2.1.0 неофициального русского дубляжа от NeuroDubStudio. Несмотря на относительно небольшой номер обновления, авторы называют его одним из самых масштабных этапов работы над проектом. Команда учла отзывы игроков, исправила проблемы с голосами и произношением, заново адаптировала весь текст игры и расширила совместимость с модификациями. Одним из главных направлений стала стабильность озвучки. Разработчики исправили скачки тембра, из-за которых один и тот же персонаж мог неожиданно менять мужской голос на женский. Также улучшили перенос особенностей оригинального исполнения и постарались вернуть эмоциональную подачу репликам. Исключение составляют ситуации, в которых изменение голоса предусмотрено самим оригиналом: например, крики, шёпот и намеренные искажения. Серьёзно переработали и синхронизацию. Теперь при расчёте продолжительности фраз учитываются паузы и тишина, благодаря чему русская озвучка должна точнее попадать в темп оригинальных диалогов. Дополнительно команда улучшила произношение, расстановку ударений, работу с буквой «ё», числами и датами. Отдельное внимание уделили дикции: проблемные записи с проглоченными звуками, словами и окончаниями прошли повторную генерацию и отбор. Однако изменения затронули не только голоса. По словам авторов, через полную переработку и сверку с английским оригиналом прошёл весь игровой текст. При этом удачные формулировки официальной русской локализации сохранили. Исправили обращения с учётом пола говор

items.title: Создатель Baldur's Gate 3 удивлен очередной номинации на The Game Awards 2026 - Свен Винке поблагодарил создателей модов
items.text: Минувшей ночью огласили полный список номинантов на главную игровую премию года The Game Awards 2026, и среди свежих релизов вновь нашлось место проверенным временем хитам. Если присутствию The Witcher 3 в отдельных категориях никто особо не удивился из-за ремастера, то вот очередное попадание туда Baldur's Gate 3 искренне порадовало как игровое сообщество, так и саму команду Larian Studios. Ролевой шедевр бельгийской студии неожиданно вернулся в гонку за статуэтками благодаря категории «Лучшее пользовательское творение». Номинантом стала масштабная сюжетная модификация A Dream of Silence: Revamped, созданная энтузиастом под ником lizardphunk. В этой номинации проект поборется за победу с такими работами, как Create Aeronautics, Nopixel V, Star Wars: Droid Tycoon и TTK Testing. Глава Larian Studios Свен Винке лично прокомментировал событие в соцсетях, выразив неподдельное восхищение работой сообщества игру: Моды для Baldur's Gate 3 просто невероятны. Видеть, как кого-то из нашего моддерского сообщества номинируют на The Game Awards — это потрясающее зрелище! Сам автор модификации эмоционально признался, что не смог сдержать слез радости. По словам энтузиаста, после 2000 часов, проведенных в игре, он посвятил официальному инструментарию BG3 Toolkit все свое свободное время на протяжении последних двух лет. Проект представляет собой полноценную глубокую кампанию, посвященную судьбе вампира Астариона. Напомним, ранее стало известно о курьезном случае, когда озвучка второстепенно

items.title: Arrowhead ответила на критику Easy Anti-Cheat в Helldivers 2 - косметические моды могут вернуть
items.text: После добавления Easy Anti-Cheat в Helldivers 2 пользователи Steam обрушили игру негативными отзывами. Arrowhead Game Studios объяснила решение и пообещала учесть отзывы: студия рассматривает возможность снова разрешить фанатские косметические модификации, если те не влияют на геймплей. Результаты этой работы должны войти в следующий хотфикс. Одной из главных претензий к античиту стала блокировка косметических модов, созданных сообществом. Arrowhead подчёркивает: официально моды не поддерживаются, но студия ищет способы вернуть безопасные косметические изменения. Модификации, затрагивающие игровой процесс, останутся под запретом: по словам разработчика, они вносят правки в код или память игры, могут влиять на стабильность у самого игрока и других участников лобби, вызывать сбои клиента и непредсказуемые результаты матчей. С технической точки зрения такие моды «неотличимы от попытки читерства», поэтому за них можно получить бан. Дорожная карта и обратная связь Arrowhead также пообещала сделать дорожную карту Helldivers 2 прозрачнее. Студия признала: шестинедельный интервал обновлений не был должным образом отражён на графическом изображении дорожной карты. В будущем команда представит более чёткий график, но сохранит «тайну траектории Галактической войны, её сюрпризы и сюжетные повороты». Отдельно разработчики извинились за формулировку про новый биом, запланированный к выпуску в прошлом месяце. По их словам, речь шла о «новом инструменте» для Мастеров игры в том, как они веду

items.text: Hello from Arrowhead, Helldivers! Our latest game update, Update 7.2, has been out for a few weeks now as well as hotfixes. As part of our continued commitment to improved transparency, here are the team’s latest reflections and our next steps for development based on this update. We poured a lot of work into the features you’ve been playing this Fall, some of which you’re actively discovering in-game over the last week (and which hit late compared to our content roadmap - more on this below). Since August you’ve collectively invaded and collapsed the Void, fought Illuminate Crushers and Wretches, activated the Terminid Control System+, celebrated Liberty Day, adopted a SEAF, provided a tank in every Super Earth citizen's driveway and more: not bad for three months! While Helldivers have plenty to celebrate recently, you’ve raised very valid concerns that some changes haven’t landed as well as we wanted, including the timing of features announced in our roadmap and the impact the move to Easy Anti-Cheat had on unsupported mods. We hear your feedback on these topics and more and we want to outline our plans for what actions we’re taking with your collective experiences in mind. Improved Roadmap Accuracy We built the second roadmap around HELLDIVERS 2 patch release dates rather than when the content in those updates would be available in the game. items.title: Elden Ring - Gameplay
items.text: Elden Ring is an action role-playing game set in third-person perspective. It includes elements that are similar to those in other FromSoftware-developed games, such as the Dark Souls series, Bloodborne, and Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice. The game is set in an open world; players can freely explore the Lands Between and its six main areas, which include Limgrave—an area of grassy plains and ancient ruins—and Caelid, a wasteland home to undead monsters. The open world is explored using the character's mount Torrent as the main mode of transportation, though players may use fast travel outside combat. Throughout the game, players encounter non-player characters (NPCs) and enemies, including demigods who rule each main area and serve as the game's main bosses. Aside from the main areas, Elden Ring has hidden dungeons, including catacombs, tunnels, and caves where players can fight bosses and gather helpful items. At the game's start, the player chooses a character class, which determines their starting spells, equipment, and attributes. Combat with enemies can be within melee, or from a distance using ranged weapons. Enemy attacks can be dodged, or blocked using shields. Spells allow players to enhance their weapons, fight enemies from afar, and restore lost hit points. The player can memorize a limited amount of these spells, which are cast using a staff or sacred seal item. items.title: Helldivers 2 - Gameplay
items.text: Helldivers 2 is a live service player versus environment (PvE) shooter game played primarily from a third-person perspective. It features cooperative multiplayer with up to four players, and does not include a dedicated single-player campaign. It provides optional cross-play. Players complete operations consisting of 1-3 procedurally generated levels (missions), conducting tasks within the missions (objectives), while facing hordes of enemies. Players choose the difficulty level of their operations, ranging from level 1 ("Trivial") to level 10 ("Super Helldive"). Players enter missions by dropping onto planets from their Super Destroyer starship in a transportation device called a "Hellpod". A core gameplay feature carried over from the first game is the use of Stratagems, powerful equipment which must be called in from their Super Destroyer by executing a sequence of directional button or arrow key inputs. Players may select up to four stratagems in advance to bring into the mission, as well as a "Booster" which affects the whole team. Friendly fire is always on during missions. In the initial days of release, gameplay involved staff at the studio observing players and influencing gameplay in real time. Players can obtain in-game currency which may be discovered in the environment during missions, or awarded by completing operations, missions, and objectives. items.title: Genshin Impact - Story
items.text: Genshin Impact takes place in the world of Teyvat, composed of seven major nations, each ruled by a god called an "Archon" and tied to a different element and ideal. The floating island of Celestia hangs above Teyvat, described as home to the gods as well as mortals who have ascended to godhood. Underground lies the ruins of Khaenri'ah, a mysterious nation destroyed by Celestia 500 years ago. Regardless of which nation they hail from, individuals who have great ambitions may be granted a Vision, a magical gemstone that allows them to control a specific element and gives them the potential to ascend to godhood and reside in Celestia. Archons, on the other hand, possess a Gnosis, a device similar to a Vision that affirms their authority as an Archon and allows them to "resonate" with Celestia. The protagonists are the Traveler and Paimon, the Traveler's guide and companion. The Traveler and their twin sibling traveled across planets before being separated in Teyvat, forcing the Traveler to go on a journey to find them. Players may choose to play as either Aether (the brother) or Lumine (the sister), and the sibling who is not picked will become separated from the other. There are no other differences between the two in terms of gameplay. items.title: Honkai: Star Rail - Plot
items.text: The game is set in a science-fantasy universe in which humanity and sapient non-human beings are aligned with specific universal concepts known as Paths. Each Path is associated with an Aeon, godlike higher-dimensional beings that preside over aspects of existence across the universe. Those who follow Paths are known as Pathstriders, which align closely with a respective Path based on their wills, while those who are directly blessed with divine powers by the Aeons are known as Emanators. They are typically enforcers of Aeons' wills often incomparably more powerful than mere mortals. Each Path espouses an ideal: for example, the Abundance is based on the view that immortality is a blessing and that healing and altruism should be valued as a top priority. The Destruction believes that civilization is cancerous to the universe, and seeks to eradicate all of civilization through the spreading of various disasters, such as the Stellaron, an object known as the Cancer of All Worlds, which brings destruction to any planet it is placed on. Some Paths were led by Aeons who are now deceased, but continue to exist without the influence of their Aeons. The main character of the game known as the Trailblazer, a mysterious amnesiac possessing a Stellaron, follows the Path of Trailblaze, a Path created by the missing Akivili. items.title: Zenless Zone Zero - Plot
items.text: Zenless Zone Zero follows the live service game model, with new updates (titled Versions) released approximately once every six weeks that add to the plot. Each Version contains quests known as Commissions, which follow the player's selected protagonist as they interact with Agents and non-playable characters, explore the Hollows and the city of New Eridu, and reveal more of the mysteries surrounding events prior to the start of the game. The game organizes major narrative arcs into Seasons, with each Season corresponding to a major Version update that increments the X value in an X.Y versioning scheme. Zenless Zone Zero takes place in the post-apocalyptic city-state of New Eridu. Large supernatural disaster zones, known as Hollows, have enveloped a majority of the planet and created alternate dimensions within the consumed space. Matter is distorted and corrupted within a Hollow due to a substance known as Ether, leading to sufficiently sentient life becoming twisted Ethereals if they remain within a Hollow for too long. Outside the Hollows, Ether is harvested as an energy source to allow for modern society to continue within New Eridu. The plot follows siblings Belle and Wise, professional Proxies who illegally guide civilians through Hollows on a for-hire basis. items.title: Jensen Huang - profile
items.text: Jen-Hsun "Jensen" Huang (born February 17, 1963) is a Taiwanese and American electrical engineer and businessman. He co-founded the technology company Nvidia, one of the world's most valuable corporations, and served as its president and CEO from its founding in 1993 until his resignation in 2026. As of November 2026, Forbes estimates his net worth at US$110.1 billion, making him the 18th-wealthiest person in the world. Born in Taipei, Huang spent his childhood in Taiwan and Thailand before immigrating to the United States. After earning a master's degree from Stanford University, he launched Nvidia alongside Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem from a Denny's restaurant in San Jose, California, in 1993. Huang led the company out of near-bankruptcy during the 1990s and oversaw its expansion from graphics processing unit (GPU) development into high-performance computing and artificial intelligence (AI). Under Huang's leadership, Nvidia experienced massive growth during the AI boom, becoming the first company to reach a market capitalization of more than $5 trillion in October 2025. In 2021 and 2024, Time magazine included him in its list of the most influential people, and later named him as one of the "Architects of AI" for its 2025 Person of the Year. He was also awarded the IEEE Medal of Honor and the National Medal of Science in 2026 for his contributions to machine learning and computational science. items.title: Nvidia - profile
items.text: Nvidia Corporation ( en-VID-ee-ə) is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units (GPUs), systems on chips (SoCs), and application programming interfaces (APIs) for gaming, data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence (AI) hardware, and mobile and automotive applications. Founded in 1993 by Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky, and Curtis Priem, Nvidia is among the largest companies by market capitalization. Originally focused on GPUs for gaming, Nvidia broadened their usage into other markets, including AI, professional visualization, and supercomputing. The company's product lines include GeForce GPUs for gaming and creative workloads, and professional GPUs for edge computing, scientific research, and industrial applications. In 2025, Nvidia became the first company to surpass US$4 trillion and US$5 trillion in market capitalization, largely driven by the AI boom and soaring demand for its AI data center hardware.

items.title: Elon Musk - profile
items.text: Elon Reeve Musk ( ; born June 28, 1971) is an industrialist, futurist, and former public official. He is the chief executive officer and largest shareholder of Tesla and SpaceX and has been the wealthiest person in the world since 2025, becoming the only trillionaire in history (in terms of US dollars) in 2026; as of November 2026, Forbes estimates his net worth to be $849.7 billion. Born into the wealthy Musk family in Pretoria, South Africa, Musk emigrated to Canada in 1989; he has Canadian citizenship as his mother was born there. He received bachelor's degrees in 1997 from the University of Pennsylvania before moving to California, United States, to pursue business ventures. In 1995, he co-founded Zip2, a web software company. Following its sale in 1999, he co-founded X.com, an e-commerce payment system that merged with Confinity in March 2000 to form PayPal. Musk also became an American citizen in 2002. In 2002, Musk founded and became CEO and chief engineer of SpaceX, a space technology company. Musk joined Tesla as an angel investor in 2004 and became its CEO and product architect in 2008. In 2015, Musk co-founded OpenAI to advance artificial intelligence (AI) research, but later left; his growing discontent with the organization's direction and leadership in the AI boom in the 2020s led him to establish xAI, which became a subsidiary of SpaceX in 2026. In 2022, he acquired Twitter, a social networking service, and made significant changes, including rebranding it as X

items.title: Sam Altman - profile
items.text: Samuel Harris Altman ( AWLT-mən; born April 22, 1985) is an American entrepreneur and investor who has been the chief executive officer (CEO) of the artificial intelligence company OpenAI since 2019. Altman attended Stanford University for two years before he dropped out and co-founded Loopt, a geosocial networking application for smartphones. Loopt was acquired by Green Dot Corporation for $43.4 million in March 2012. In 2011, Altman joined Y Combinator, a technology startup accelerator and venture capital firm, and was the company's president from 2014 to 2019. He is a billionaire, due to investments in over 400 companies including Reddit, Worldcoin, Helion Energy and Instacart. Altman co-founded OpenAI in 2015 and became its CEO in 2019, a role that made him a prominent figure of the AI boom. He supervised the launch of ChatGPT in November 2022. In 2023, he was ousted by the organization's board of directors for not being "consistently candid". The move was met with significant backlash from employees and investors, resulting in Altman's reinstatement five days later and the formation of a new board.

items.title: Satya Nadella - profile
items.text: Satya Narayana Nadella (born 19 August 1967) is an Indian-American business executive. He is the chairman and chief executive officer (CEO) of Microsoft, succeeding Steve Ballmer in 2014 as CEO and John W. Thompson in 2021 as chairman. Before becoming CEO, he was the executive vice president of Microsoft's cloud and enterprise group, responsible for building and running the company's computing platforms.
